name: Small apartment kitchen
desc: Late food eaten standing up; the room where people say the real thing while facing the sink.
tags: small apartment kitchen, indoors, narrow counter, stainless sink, dripping faucet, gas stove, kettle on the burner, refrigerator covered in magnets, wall cabinets, dish rack, tiled backsplash, small window above the sink, linoleum floor, ceiling light
prose: a cramped apartment kitchen with a chipped counter running to a sink under one narrow window, a gas stove with a kettle on it, a fridge covered in magnets and a dish rack draining beside the tap
note: The word kitchen alone buys a showroom - granite island, two sinks, daylight from nowhere. Smallness is not an adjective the model can render; it comes from naming ONE counter run, wall cabinets low over it and a single narrow window, then framing intimate. Clutter has to be listed as objects (dish rack, kettle, magnets) or every surface comes out bare. Never tag dim or cosy - that is the look's job.
